```{r}
# R/01_scrape.R
# Purpose: Get Chipotle store locations via Overpass API (OpenStreetMap)
#          then join Census median household income by zip via tidycensus
# Methods: API access (Overpass/OSM) + API access (tidycensus/Census Bureau)
# Outputs: data/chipotle_locations_raw.csv
#          data/chipotle_locations_clean.csv

library(tidyverse)
library(httr2)
library(tidycensus)
library(janitor)
library(sf)
library(tigris)

# ── 1. Load credentials ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
census_key <- Sys.getenv("CENSUS_API_KEY")
if (census_key == "") stop("CENSUS_API_KEY not found. Did you restart R after editing .Renviron?")
census_api_key(census_key, install = FALSE)

# ── 2. Fetch all US Chipotle locations from OpenStreetMap Overpass API ─────
cat("Querying Overpass API for US Chipotle locations...\n")

overpass_query <- '
[out:json][timeout:120];
(
  node["name"="Chipotle Mexican Grill"]["amenity"="fast_food"](24.0,-125.0,50.0,-66.0);
  way["name"="Chipotle Mexican Grill"]["amenity"="fast_food"](24.0,-125.0,50.0,-66.0);
  node["name"="Chipotle Mexican Grill"]["amenity"="fast_food"](18.0,-168.0,22.0,-154.0);
  way["name"="Chipotle Mexican Grill"]["amenity"="fast_food"](18.0,-168.0,22.0,-154.0);
);
out center;
'

resp <- request("https://overpass-api.de/api/interpreter") |>
  req_body_form(data = overpass_query) |>
  req_timeout(120) |>
  req_error(is_error = \(r) FALSE) |>
  req_perform()

cat("HTTP status:", resp_status(resp), "\n")

if (resp_status(resp) != 200) {
  stop("Overpass API request failed. Check your internet connection and try again.")
}

# ── 3. Parse the JSON response ─────────────────────────────────────────────
body <- resp_body_json(resp)
elements <- body$elements

cat("Raw elements returned:", length(elements), "\n")

parse_element <- function(el) {
  tags <- el$tags %||% list()
  tibble(
    osm_id        = as.character(el$id %||% NA),
    osm_type      = el$type            %||% NA_character_,
    latitude      = as.numeric(el$lat  %||% el$center$lat %||% NA),
    longitude     = as.numeric(el$lon  %||% el$center$lon %||% NA),
    name          = tags$name                %||% NA_character_,
    address       = tags$`addr:housenumber`  %||% NA_character_,
    street        = tags$`addr:street`       %||% NA_character_,
    city          = tags$`addr:city`         %||% NA_character_,
    state         = tags$`addr:state`        %||% NA_character_,
    zip           = tags$`addr:postcode`     %||% NA_character_,
    phone         = tags$phone               %||% NA_character_,
    website       = tags$website             %||% NA_character_,
    opening_hours = tags$opening_hours       %||% NA_character_
  )
}

locations_raw <- elements |>
  map(possibly(parse_element, otherwise = NULL)) |>
  list_rbind()

cat("Rows parsed:", nrow(locations_raw), "\n")

# Save raw immediately
dir.create("data", showWarnings = FALSE)
write_csv(locations_raw, "data/chipotle_locations_raw.csv")
cat("✓ Saved: data/chipotle_locations_raw.csv\n")

# ── 4. Clean ───────────────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\nCleaning location data...\n")

locations_clean <- locations_raw |>
  clean_names() |>
  mutate(
    full_address = case_when(
      !is.na(address) & !is.na(street) ~ paste(address, street),
      !is.na(street)                   ~ street,
      TRUE                             ~ NA_character_
    ),
    zip   = str_extract(zip, "^\\d{5}"),
    state = str_to_upper(str_trim(state)),
    city  = str_to_title(str_trim(city))
  ) |>
  filter(str_detect(state, "^[A-Z]{2}$") | is.na(state)) |>
  distinct(latitude, longitude, .keep_all = TRUE) |>
  mutate(store_id = row_number())

cat("Locations after cleaning:", nrow(locations_clean), "\n")
cat("Locations with zip codes:", sum(!is.na(locations_clean$zip)), "\n")
cat("Locations missing zip codes:", sum(is.na(locations_clean$zip)), "\n")

# ── 5. Fill missing zips via spatial join ──────────────────────────────────
missing_zip <- locations_clean |>
  filter(is.na(zip), !is.na(latitude), !is.na(longitude))

cat("Attempting to fill", nrow(missing_zip), "missing zips via spatial join...\n")

if (nrow(missing_zip) > 0) {

  # Download ZCTA boundaries
  zcta_shapes <- tryCatch(
    tigris::zctas(year = 2020, progress_bar = FALSE),
    error = \(e) {
      cat("Could not download ZCTA shapes — missing zips will stay NA\n")
      NULL
    }
  )

  if (!is.null(zcta_shapes)) {
    # Convert missing-zip stores to sf points
    missing_sf <- missing_zip |>
      st_as_sf(coords = c("longitude", "latitude"), crs = 4326)

    # Align CRS before spatial join
    zcta_shapes <- st_transform(zcta_shapes, crs = 4326)

    # Spatial join
    joined <- st_join(missing_sf, zcta_shapes |> select(ZCTA5CE20)) |>
      st_drop_geometry() |>
      select(osm_id, zip_filled = ZCTA5CE20)

    # Merge filled zips back
    locations_clean <- locations_clean |>
      left_join(joined, by = "osm_id") |>
      mutate(zip = coalesce(zip, zip_filled)) |>
      select(-zip_filled)

    cat("Zips after spatial fill:", sum(!is.na(locations_clean$zip)), "\n")
  }
}

# ── 6. Pull median household income by zip from tidycensus ────────────────
cat("\nPulling Census ACS income data by zip code...\n")

income_by_zip <- get_acs(
  geography = "zcta",
  variables = "B19013_001",
  year      = 2022,
  survey    = "acs5",
  progress  = FALSE
) |>
  clean_names() |>
  transmute(
    zip           = str_extract(geoid, "\\d{5}"),
    median_income = estimate,
    income_moe    = moe
  )

cat("Zip codes with income data:", nrow(income_by_zip), "\n")

# ── 7. Join locations to income ────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("Joining locations to income data...\n")

locations_with_income <- locations_clean |>
  left_join(income_by_zip, by = "zip") |>
  mutate(
    income_quintile = ntile(median_income, 5),
    income_quintile_label = case_when(
      income_quintile == 1 ~ "Q1 Lowest",
      income_quintile == 2 ~ "Q2 Low",
      income_quintile == 3 ~ "Q3 Middle",
      income_quintile == 4 ~ "Q4 High",
      income_quintile == 5 ~ "Q5 Highest",
      TRUE                 ~ "Unknown"
    )
  )

# ── 8. Validation table ────────────────────────────────────────────────────
cat("\n── Validation Summary ──────────────────────────────\n")

validation <- locations_with_income |>
  summarise(
    total_locations      = n(),
    has_zip              = sum(!is.na(zip)),
    has_coordinates      = sum(!is.na(latitude) & !is.na(longitude)),
    has_income           = sum(!is.na(median_income)),
    missing_income       = sum(is.na(median_income)),
    income_join_rate_pct = round(mean(!is.na(median_income)) * 100, 1),
    avg_median_income    = round(mean(median_income, na.rm = TRUE), 0),
    stores_q1_lowest     = sum(income_quintile_label == "Q1 Lowest", na.rm = TRUE),
    stores_q5_highest    = sum(income_quintile_label == "Q5 Highest", na.rm = TRUE)
  )

print(validation)

locations_validated <- locations_with_income |>
  mutate(
    flag_missing_zip    = is.na(zip),
    flag_missing_income = is.na(median_income),
    flag_missing_coords = is.na(latitude) | is.na(longitude),
    flag_invalid_state  = !str_detect(state, "^[A-Z]{2}$") & !is.na(state),
    flag_any_issue      = flag_missing_zip | flag_missing_income |
                          flag_missing_coords | flag_invalid_state
  )

cat("Total flagged rows:", sum(locations_validated$flag_any_issue), "\n")
cat("Flag breakdown:\n")
locations_validated |>
  summarise(across(starts_with("flag_"), sum)) |>
  pivot_longer(everything(), names_to = "flag", values_to = "count") |>
  print()

# ── 9. Save final output ───────────────────────────────────────────────────
write_csv(locations_validated, "data/chipotle_locations_clean.csv")

cat("\n✓ Saved: data/chipotle_locations_clean.csv\n")
cat("\nSample rows:\n")
locations_validated |>
  select(store_id, city, state, zip, median_income, income_quintile_label) |>
  head(10) |>
  print()
```
